# H who noticed

## The heuristic

**Ask who noticed first. That single answer selects the whole response.**


_Why:_ A customer-initiated escalation is a relationship event: the customer has concluded that normal handling will not work, and technical speed alone does not restore that belief. An internally-triggered one is a process event, and treating it as a relationship event creates a problem the customer did not have.
